name: My Duke of Winter
source:
Trapped in a hunting cabin by a snowstorm, you and your companion the Duke decide to stave off the cold - and boredom - by having a little fun together.

Or: a short, plot-free, animated erotic fangame featuring Rodrigue Achille Fraldarius from Fire Emblem: 3 Houses.

[From [url=https://damnilovefaerghus.itch.io/my-duke-of-winter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
暴风雪将你和同行的公爵困在了一间狩猎小屋里。你们决定一起找点乐子，驱散寒冷，也打发无聊。

或者说：这是一部以《火焰之纹章：风花雪月》中的罗德利古·亚希尔·伏拉鲁达力乌斯为主角的短篇色情同人游戏，没有剧情，包含动画。

（摘自[url=https://damnilovefaerghus.itch.io/my-duke-of-winter]itch.io[/url]）
